div.head: CHn cor 2.1
div.ab: Similiter et homines baronum meorum legitima et iusta releuatione releuabunt terras suas de dominis suis.
Similiter et homines baronum meorum iusta et legitima relevatione relevabunt terras suas de dominis suis.
Similarly, the vassals of my barons shall pay the just and lawful relief for their lands to their lords.
div.note: Added October 2026 from Robertson pp. 276–277 (text and translation); Liebermann’s text added from Gesetze I p. 521, October 2026 (two independent readings of the page images)

note.seg: Aufrechte (‘Antiqua’-)Buchstabennoten beziehen sich auf Band II: Erklärungen.
Upright (‘Antiqua’, i.e. roman) letters used as note-markers refer to Band II: Erklärungen.
Nur lehnrechtlich also schützt der oberste Lehnsherr die Aftervassallen, nicht der nationale König die Untertanen; ebenso 4, 2; s. Gl Lehnwesen 6; o. Einl. 9. 13
It is thus only in feudal terms that the supreme feudal lord protects the sub-vassals, not as national king that he protects his subjects; likewise 4, 2; see Gl Lehnwesen 6; above Introduction 9. 13
